purpose: Control the v14a4 signal-quality confound before interpreting persistent family failures as learning or optimization limitations.
tokenizer_contract: unchanged from v14a4: tokenizer_v9 with canonical special-token IDs

training_mechanics.objective: full chosen-answer continuation CE with prompt tokens masked

supervision_repair.rule: After the pinned v14a4 dataset is verified, any target-family chosen continuation missing a dropout route signal or overfitting/generalization family signal receives a deterministic family-specific sentence. All repaired target rows are revalidated before training.

legacy_replay_policy.mapping_rule: A replay row is family-mapped only when its chosen answer contains a route signal and has one unique highest positive family-signal score. Ties, broad route-only rows, and rows without route signals remain legacy_generic.

sampling_policy.family_schedule: round-robin within each route on every route occurrence
sampling_policy.replay_fallback: If no unused mapped replay exists for the current route/family, use authored behavior for that same family.

evaluation.interpretation: If the signal precondition passes and any gradient_clipping family still fails clean family evaluation, record strong evidence (not causal proof) for a learning/optimization limitation rather than an obvious supervision/exposure defect.
